summary: Iteration 13 (Aptoide distribution + Share App flows) — BACKEND & FRONTEND BOTH PASS. All 3 new backend endpoint tests green and every requested frontend flow verified on the mobile (390x844) web preview after logging in as delivered+t1@resend.dev.

integration_issues.issue: Share.share rejects with 'Share is not supported in this browser' on web and the rejection is not caught, so Expo dev shows a red error overlay AFTER the sheet closes. The sheet still closes cleanly (onClose() runs before Share.share), and on Android native (production target) Share.share is supported, so this is a dev-only artefact. Suggest wrapping await Share.share(...) in try/catch to also silence the unhandled rejection on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/share-app.tsx:27-30

action_items: (Optional, polish) Wrap `await Share.share(...)` in /app/frontend/src/components/share-app.tsx inside a try/catch so the web dev-mode unhandled rejection ('Share is not supported in this browser') is suppressed; current behaviour is only visible in Expo dev and does not affect Android native builds.

rca_of_issue: The 'Share is not supported in this browser' uncaught promise is purely a dev-mode symptom of calling React Native's Share.share from the Expo web preview, where no web polyfill is registered. Root cause: pick() in share-app.tsx awaits Share.share without a try/catch. On production (Android) Share.share resolves normally, so no end-user impact. Mitigation (optional): wrap in try/catch and swallow or toast the error.
